svg.text: A168 S2 node BR139/TRH-25: multibox.normalise BEFORE (committed A171: K' rebuilt from the union hull) and AFTER (A172: exact intersection of per-piece K'), same settings nsub=4 refine=3
box: kept fraction, K' used by the clip, K' of the pieces (BEFORE -> AFTER)
thin rects = surviving centre pieces (one per tilt sub-bin); solid = exact intersection of the per-piece K' at that fixed point; dashed = the K' the clip actually used (hull before, per-piece after)
the band between dashed and solid in the BEFORE panel is the growth the hull rebuild threw away each pass; AFTER it should vanish (dashed on solid)
faint squares = hypothesis square at box centre, mid-tilt, with extremal-tilt outlines; container [0,s]^2, s = 3.877084
kills on the BEFORE fixed point stand (hull K' is a subset of the true K'); only ALIVE verdicts were weakened
